rezzy::state::cache

Struct LeanEventCache 

Source 
pub struct LeanEventCache<Id: EventId, C: EventContent = Value> { /* private fields */ }
Expand description

A fixed-capacity LRU cache for pre-constructed LeanEvents.

Events are stored as Arc<LeanEvent<Id, C>> for cheap cloning. When the cache exceeds capacity, the least-recently-used entry is evicted.

The cache is not internally synchronized — callers must wrap it in a Mutex or RwLock for concurrent access. This keeps the core no_std compatible while allowing std users to choose their synchronization strategy.

§Implementation

Uses a HashMap for O(1) key lookup plus a BTreeMap<u64, Id> side-index for O(log n) LRU eviction. The BTreeMap maps generation ticks to event IDs, so pop_first() instantly yields the least-recently-used entry.

§Interior mutability

The BTreeMap side-index is wrapped in RefCell and per-entry last_access fields use Cell<u64> so that the EventProvider implementation (which takes &self) can update LRU state. This ensures events accessed through the lazy resolver path are properly marked as recently used and not prematurely evicted.

pub fn insert(&mut self, event: LeanEvent<Id, C>) -> Arc<LeanEvent<Id, C>>

Inserts a LeanEvent, wrapping it in Arc. If the cache is at capacity, the least-recently-used entry is evicted first.

If an event with the same ID already exists, it is replaced.

Source

pub fn insert_arc(&mut self, event: Arc<LeanEvent<Id, C>>)

Inserts a pre-wrapped Arc<LeanEvent>. Useful when the caller already has an Arc (e.g., from a shared database layer).

Source

pub fn get_or_insert<Q>( &mut self, id: &Q, f: impl FnOnce() -> LeanEvent<Id, C>, ) -> Arc<LeanEvent<Id, C>>
where Id: Borrow<Q>, Q: ?Sized + Eq + Hash,

Gets an event by ID, or inserts one created by the closure if missing.

This is the primary API for homeserver integration — the closure typically converts a native PDU type into a LeanEvent:

let event = cache.get_or_insert("$abc", || {
    // Convert from native PDU type
    LeanEvent {
        event_id: "$abc".into(),
        event_type: "m.room.member".into(),
        sender: "@alice:x".into(),
        state_key: Some("@alice:x".into()),
        depth: 1,
        ..Default::default()
    }
});
§Panics (debug only)

In debug builds, panics if the closure returns a LeanEvent whose event_id does not match the requested id.

Source

pub fn insert_batch( &mut self, events: impl IntoIterator<Item = LeanEvent<Id, C>>, ) -> HashMap<Id, Arc<LeanEvent<Id, C>>>

Inserts a batch of events, returning a HashMap of Arcs.

Events already in the cache are returned from cache (updating LRU). Missing events are inserted.

Trait Implementations§

Source§

impl<Id: EventId, C: EventContent> EventProvider<Id, C> for LeanEventCache<Id, C>

LeanEventCache implements EventProvider so it can be passed directly to resolve_state_maps_lazy_with_diff.

Unlike a plain HashMap provider, this implementation updates the LRU generation for every access through interior mutability (Cell + RefCell), ensuring that events heavily used during lazy resolution are not prematurely evicted.
